title: Minimal card
caption: A quiet off-white card with a near-black button, for minimal and monochrome sites.
alt: Cookie consent banner as a floating off-white card at the bottom of a light page, with dark grey text and a near-black Save my preferences button with slightly rounded corners.

title: Dark mint bar
caption: A wide dark bar across the bottom with a mint button, for dark-themed sites.
alt: Cookie consent banner as a wide near-black bar across the bottom of a dark page, with white text and a mint green Save my preferences button with black text and slightly rounded corners.

title: Corporate top bar
caption: A wide white bar across the top with a navy, square-cornered button.
alt: Cookie consent banner as a wide white bar across the top of a white page, with dark grey text and a navy blue Save my preferences button with square corners.

title: Centered violet
caption: A wide pale-violet panel centred on the page, with a pill-shaped violet button and slightly smaller text.
alt: Cookie consent banner as a wide pale violet panel centred vertically on a pale violet page, with smaller dark grey text and a violet pill-shaped Save my preferences button with fully rounded corners.

title: Warm left card
caption: A narrow cream card at the bottom left with a burnt-orange pill button, for warm, editorial sites.
alt: Cookie consent banner as a narrow cream card floating at the bottom left of a cream page, with dark grey text and a burnt orange pill-shaped Save my preferences button with fully rounded corners.

title: Dark rose side panel
caption: A full-height dark panel down the right side with a rose, square-cornered button.
alt: Cookie consent banner as a tall near-black panel running the full height of the right side of a dark page, with white text and a rose pink Save my preferences button with black text and square corners.

title: Large text teal
caption: A white bottom card with a teal button and larger text, for readability-first sites.
alt: Cookie consent banner as a floating white card at the bottom of a white page, with larger dark grey text and a teal Save my preferences button with slightly rounded corners.

title: Blue top card
caption: A white card floating at the top with a bright blue button, for clean product sites.
alt: Cookie consent banner as a floating white card at the top of a white page, with dark grey text and a bright blue Save my preferences button with slightly rounded corners.

title: Compact bottom bar
caption: Compact style as a single-row white bar across the bottom, with navy links, for sites that want the banner to take as little height as possible.
alt: v2 consent banner in the compact style as a single-row white bar across the bottom of a white page: the heading on the left, then the message with a navy Privacy policy link, then Private and Personalized buttons with grey borders and a Customize button, with download and close icons at the far right.

title: Compact top bar, dark
caption: Compact style as a single-row dark bar across the top, with mint links, for dark-themed sites.
alt: v2 consent banner in the compact style as a single-row near-black bar across the top of a dark page: a white heading on the left, then the white message with a mint Privacy policy link, then Private and Personalized buttons with grey borders and a Customize button, with download and close icons at the far right.

title: Compact floating card
caption: Compact style as a wide pale-violet card floating at the bottom, with pill-shaped buttons and violet links.
alt: v2 consent banner in the compact style as a wide pale violet card floating at the bottom of a pale violet page: the heading in the top row beside download and close icons, the message with a violet Privacy policy link below it, then pill-shaped Private and Personalized buttons and a pill-shaped Customize button.

title: Standard bottom card
caption: Standard style as a wide white card floating at the bottom, with all three levels and teal links.
alt: v2 consent banner in the standard style as a wide white card floating at the bottom of a white page: the site domain at top left with download and close icons at top right, a centred heading and message with a teal Privacy policy link, then Private, Balanced and Personalized buttons and a Customize button in one centred row.

title: Standard centered
caption: Standard style as a cream panel centred on the page, with pill-shaped buttons and burnt-orange links, for warm, editorial sites.
alt: v2 consent banner in the standard style as a cream panel centred over a cream page: the site domain at top left with download and close icons at top right, a centred heading and message with a burnt orange Privacy policy link, then pill-shaped Private, Balanced and Personalized buttons and a pill-shaped Customize button.

title: Standard right panel
caption: Standard style as a full-height dark panel down the right side, with square-cornered buttons and rose links.
alt: v2 consent banner in the standard style as a near-black panel running the full height of the right side of a dark page: the site domain and the download and close icons at the top, a centred white heading and message with a rose Privacy policy link, then square-cornered Private, Balanced and Personalized buttons, with the Customize button on its own row below them.

title: Compact on a phone
caption: Compact style on a phone: two level buttons and a Customize button side by side in one row.
alt: v2 consent banner in the compact style on a phone-sized screen, as a white sheet across the bottom of a white page: the heading in the top row beside download and close icons, the message with a blue Privacy policy link, then Private, Personalized and a lighter-bordered Customize button side by side in one row.

title: Standard on a phone
caption: Standard style on a phone: the three levels and Customize stacked as full-width buttons.
alt: v2 consent banner in the standard style on a phone-sized screen, as an off-white card floating at the bottom of an off-white page: the site domain with download and close icons at the top, a centred heading and message with a near-black Privacy policy link, then full-width Private, Balanced and Personalized buttons stacked in a column, with a full-width Customize button last.
